text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A supernova.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It marks the demise of a giant star.
Yet its explosion illuminates
the entire cosmos with dazzling radiance—
becoming a cradle that fosters a thousand
stars.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In this universe, too,
a tremendous supernova once occurred.
That blinding explosion...
transformed racing itself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Horse girls boasting unbelievable late-stage
bursts appeared. Many girls
inspired by them emerged,
turning fierce speed contests into the
dominant standard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore,
horse girls who honed their late kicks to
dominate races
with sensational explosive acceleration rose
up—and are now becoming the new center of
the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, there is not just one star.
Stars that boast immense brilliance on
specific turf routes,
stars whose light reaches across oceans...
countless glittering lights drift across
the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of cataclysmic explosion that
standout, brilliant star will ignite—
not even the universe knows.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a rookie trainer,
there are infinite things to learn for the
sake of my horse girls. To hone my skills,
I attended a special lecture hosted by the URA.
Just then—
choice_data_list: (...Why is there a horse girl here?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The person quietly slipping into the room
was a Tracen Academy horse girl.
This lecture
was supposed to be for trainers learning
how to properly instruct their athletes,
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After becoming an Oaks winner in Japan,
she accomplished the
groundbreaking feat of being the first
Japanese Umamusume to win the American
Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, that is correct.
My recovery took far longer than
expected...
So, during that time...
I decided to prepare for my next dream.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Nurturing the future. To that end,
I began studying instruction
step by step...
and received special permission to attend
today's lecture.
choice_data_list: I see. You really are a hard worker.
I see. You really are a hard worker.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No...
I am merely desperate to make up for my lack
of experience.
...I knew it beforehand,
but instructing others is truly difficult.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a few students. However,
among them is one...
how should I put it,
a girl with quite the tremendous
personality...
WOOOOOOAAAAAAHHH!!!!

More! More... ACCELERATE!
That's way better,
it has to be! Here I GOOOOOOO—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turf kicks up violently beneath her strides.
I can feel explosive energy
bursting from her,
like power overflowing past its limits.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not again...!
I specifically told her to wait for me...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The student I am instructing—
Epiphaneia-san.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
!
Just now... I heard it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Over this way!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wait, what about our training session...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before I know it,
Cesario and I are running after her.
I don't even know why. Except...—
choice_data_list: (I just can't take my eyes off tha...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Found her!
Up there, on the second floor...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Where is it?
No—found it, right here!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sparks practically fly before my eyes.
Our gazes lock with that much raw
intensity.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—I knew it!
It's you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hold on, I'm coming down!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Wait,
there are obstacles down below...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
Because destiny—has got my back!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Everything seems to move in slow motion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The second Epiphaneia leaps out... by chance,
a window swings open,
and by chance,
a strong gust of wind blows in...
pushing her forward. And then—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
See that?!
Told ya I'd be fine!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Now then—you!
Become my Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I want you to! No, you definitely have to!
Even the 'Voice of Destiny'—yep,
it says so too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's do it, right now,
this very second!
You'll be my Trainer, won't you?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Right on!
I knew—I just knew that's what you'd say!
Looking forward to working with you,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I refuse to get swept up in the momentum.
My destiny and hers simply do not align.
